//: parallel:1 runs tasks serially. Builds emit into libs/<project>/dist and the web/mobile builds type-check against libs/universal/dist; running universal:build concurrently with a dependent's build let universal's `clean` (rm -rf dist) briefly empty that dir mid-read, causing intermittent 'Cannot find module' failures. Serializing removes the race; the dependsOn graph still orders universal:build before its dependents.

test.//: Tests run against TypeScript source (vitest resolves the base package + own alias to libs/*/src). No build is required, so this target has no build dependency. Built-artifact / CJS-shape correctness is covered separately by each lib's `test:interop`.
